Centered section label and descriptive line are adjacent; running gazette title repeats.
Large centered title wraps; section summaries refer to operative sections elsewhere. Membership of each label remains open.

Five-column schedule form with outer border and internal ruled rows.
Labeled contract forms and a multi-column proposer comparison grid.
Financial rows align under three numeric columns; sparse horizontal rules, no full cell grid. Not classified as strictly unruled.
Chart includes a vertical axis label; body text contains pointers to sections and a table.
A cell-grid instrument table and a sparsely ruled numeric table occur on the same page.
Multi-line large title above dotted-leader section entries and page references.
Dense financial tables use grouped numeric columns and horizontal rules without full cell borders.
Displayed mathematical expressions interleave with prose. This is formula layout evidence, not a claim of rotated text on this page.
Centered front-matter lines include meeting identity, date and minutes label; body points to an annex. Exact title/subtitle units remain unadjudicated.
Participant table uses two columns and vertically merged country/organization cells.
Left/right administrative headers, centered title and descriptive line, diagonal watermark. Not two-column body text.
Linked contents entries plus RFC running header/footer, also visible on page 30.
Lightly bordered protocol tables include section references; RFC margin text repeats.
Invitation title and two-line event description below administrative front matter. Title/subtitle extent is not assigned here.
Program title and two-line event description precede a three-column agenda grid. Column labels are visually distinct; membership decisions are not recorded in shape audit.
